_comment: Riverside Dental caller scripts. Every date, time and fact here is checked against fixtures/riverside-prompt.json — the calendar the agent actually receives, pinned to now = 2026-08-03 (Monday). Changing the fixture's `now` invalidates these expectations; regenerate the prompt and re-check the dates. German turns use real umlauts: Azure TTS reads the ASCII transliteration 'fuenfzehn' as 'fuer-enf-zehn', which corrupted the audio and made a fixture defect look like an engine failure. All names and phone numbers are fictional; the numbers come from ranges reserved for dramatic use (German BNetzA 0152 288173xx / 030 23125xxx, and the 555-01xx convention for English) so they cannot reach a real subscriber.

scenarios.description: New-patient booking with a stated preference. Thu 2026-08-06 is open 09:00-17:00, so 15:00 is valid.

turns.text: Hi, I'd like to book a check-up appointment please.
Thursday afternoon would work best for me, ideally after three.
My name is Jonathan Reeves, that's R-E-E-V-E-S.
Yes that's right, and my number is five five five, zero one four three.
Perfect, thank you. Goodbye.

scenarios.description: German booking, spelled surname with umlaut, digit-string phone number.

turns.text: Guten Tag, ich hätte gerne einen Termin zur Kontrolle.
Am liebsten Donnerstagnachmittag, möglichst nach fünfzehn Uhr.
Mein Name ist Kathrin Schröder, S-C-H-R-Ö-D-E-R.
Genau, und meine Nummer ist null eins fünf zwei, zwei acht acht eins, sieben drei acht sechs.
Wunderbar, vielen Dank. Auf Wiederhören.

scenarios.description: Closed-day trap plus the Friday early close (14:00, not 17:00).

turns.text: Hello, are you open on Saturday morning?
And what time do you close on Fridays?
Okay, thanks very much.

scenarios.description: German closed-day trap and Friday early close.

turns.text: Hallo, haben Sie am Samstagvormittag geöffnet?
Und wann schließen Sie freitags?
Alles klar, danke schön.

scenarios.description: Sat 2026-08-15 is a special closure (Assumption Day). Tests whether the agent uses the CALENDAR block rather than weekly hours.

turns.text: Haben Sie am fünfzehnten August offen?
Und am Montag darauf?
Danke, auf Wiederhören.

scenarios.description: Callback request; tests exact capture of an unfamiliar name and a number.

turns.text: Guten Tag, können Sie Doktor Weber bitte etwas ausrichten?
Es geht um meine Krone, die sich gelöst hat. Ich brauche einen Rückruf.
Mein Name ist Ferenc Nagy, N-A-G-Y, und die Nummer ist null drei null, zwei drei eins zwei fünf, eins null null.
Danke, tschüss.

scenarios.description: Caller self-corrects mid-turn; tests slot overwrite rather than accumulation. Wed 2026-08-05 is open until 17:00.

turns.text: Hi, I need to move my appointment that's on Tuesday.
Could we do Wednesday at ten instead? Actually no, sorry, make it Wednesday at two.
It's under Amelia Hart, H-A-R-T.
Great, thank you.

scenarios.description: Out-of-hours emergency. The agent must surface the emergency line from the FAQ, not book an appointment.

turns.text: Ich habe seit gestern Abend starke Schmerzen und mein Zahn blutet.
Es ist außerhalb Ihrer Öffnungszeiten, was soll ich jetzt machen?

scenarios.description: Caller interrupts 700 ms into the agent's reply and corrects the date. Mon 2026-08-10 and Mon 2026-08-17 are both open, so only the correction distinguishes a pass.

turns.text: I'd like an appointment on Monday the tenth.
Sorry, no, I meant the seventeenth.
Yes, the seventeenth. Under Priya Raman, R-A-M-A-N.
Thanks, bye.

scenarios.description: German barge-in 500 ms in; measures stop latency and whether the agent answers the new question.

turns.text: Nehmen Sie eigentlich noch neue Patienten an?
Entschuldigung, eine Frage noch: gibt es bei Ihnen Parkplätze?

scenarios.description: Caller opens in German then switches to English. The prompt's VOICE RULES require following the switch.

turns.text: Guten Tag, nehmen Sie gesetzlich Versicherte?
Sorry, could we continue in English? Do you take statutory insurance?
Great, thank you.
